source_run_artifact.artifact: Public surrounding municipalities and verified civic reference points

items.caption: Mean nearest-rail walking minutes in 500 m cells with at least five observations. White lines show study neighbourhoods; grey borders show surrounding municipalities. Stars are the verified civic references. Shared colours are capped at the pooled 95th percentile for display; the table retains uncapped values. Context has no analytical role. Sources: OpenStreetMap, Inside Airbnb, DAGI/DAWA, Kartverket and Statistics Sweden.

Complete-case MEW adjusted observational associations, not causal effects or predictive importance. Rail/bus Euclidean predictors use km, walking uses minutes and opportunities use log(1+count); coefficient magnitudes across different units are not rankings. HC3 intervals shown;9,999-replication restricted Webb results are in the table. Uniform 10% eligibility is a disclosed post-observation amendment.

All three reversed city pairs for both estimators and every model. Descriptive differences only: changing direction changes training city, target distribution and sample size. No independent-direction test or exchangeability assumption is made.

Existing heldout XGBoost MEW contributions only; no new SHAP calculation or model fit. Ten encoded terms selected for display by across-city mean magnitude; this does not change the model. Unavailable encodings remain missing rather than zero. Each term’s actual support is in the table. Correlated E/W attribution is descriptive, not causal.

Frozen nearest-category distance excess: median dots, interquartile thick bars and 5th–95th percentile thin bars. These are distribution summaries, not confidence intervals or same-object route circuity.

Matched nearest-category Euclidean and walking-equivalent distances. Walking minutes convert using the frozen 5 km/h speed. Plotting log(1+distance) retains zeros and tails; tick labels are km. Hexagons require n≥5. Colour shows logarithmic bin frequency; diagonal is equality. Nearest destinations may differ, so this is not same-destination circuity.

Horizontal bars show paired walking-versus-baseline error for OLS and XGBoost in every held-out neighbourhood. Negative bars favour walking. These are full-fold scores, not confidence intervals. Minimum 15 test/500 training support is unchanged; full names, counts and all model scores are exported.

Median reachable destinations (dots) and interquartile ranges (bars) for frozen nominal 10-minute walking and matched 833 m Euclidean budgets. Same deduplicated category universe within each city. Zero counts are observed zeros; no route failures are filled.

All five primary paired comparisons. Bars are frozen 95% geographic-composition stability ranges from 2,000 neighbourhood resamples. They are not independent-sample confidence intervals; a range crossing zero does not establish equivalence. MW−ME is replacement; MEW−ME is network add-on.

Points are pooled listing-weighted OOF RMSE. Whiskers are 10th–90th percentiles of unweighted heldout-neighbourhood RMSE, not inferential confidence intervals; pooled points need not equal fold medians. Four models share each city’s observations and folds. Native-currency log outcomes; lower error is better.

Frozen 8-nearest-neighbour/499-permutation diagnostics for observed outcomes and primary OOF residuals. City metric CRSs retained. Material OLS MW residual dependence triggered the registered spatial-error association sensitivity in each city; prediction gains are not a claim of independent residuals.

Every registered predictive family: paired MW−M0 point changes and frozen 95% geographic-composition stability ranges. N/A denotes native density checks inapplicable to Copenhagen/Oslo; no value is filled. Samples and measurement definitions differ across rows, so this is not an absolute-score ranking or pass/fail test.

items.caption: White boundaries delineate all 11 Copenhagen–Frederiksberg, 17 Oslo and 11 Stockholm study neighbourhoods. Grey borders show real surrounding municipalities for context only. Stars mark Copenhagen City Hall Square and the verified Oslo/Stockholm City Hall points. Native city CRSs and scales differ. Sources: Inside Airbnb, DAGI/DAWA, Kartverket, Statistics Sweden and pinned civic references.

All six directional accessibility-versus-baseline point contrasts. Same target observations within every comparison; negative values favour accessibility. These correlated directional results are not pooled into an independent significance test.

Direct network replacement (MW−ME) and add-on (MEW−ME) for all six directions. Bars are existing 95% target-neighbourhood composition stability ranges; they do not establish independent directions or equivalence.

All six source→target directions for both estimators and all four models. Rows are source, columns target; diagonal is untested, never zero. Common colour scale. Source-only fitted pipelines and observed target price benchmarks are frozen; no target fitting/recalibration or absolute-price deployment.

Saved XGBoost MEW predictions versus actual relative log price in all six directions. Only aggregate rectangular bins with n≥5 are displayed; every target row remains in full metrics. Shared axes; diagonal is perfect relative prediction. No row export, target fitting, smoothing or recalibration.

Pooled OOF errors on the same frozen city samples under random, primary neighbourhood and six fixed spatial-block configurations. Lines connect categorical designs, not a continuous treatment. Different holdout geometry changes the prediction task; overlapping training sets and correlated configurations prevent independent-replication claims.
